isolation.condition_l: Only the frozen NumStability source tree and exact pruned compiled Lean tree are added as read-only mounts.
isolation.condition_n: NumStability source, compiled files, names, documentation, indexes, and caches are absent. Each complete staged task is scanned and a real import probe must fail before the agent starts.
isolation.gold_proof_policy: The private construction proofs and source PDFs are never mounted in an evaluated attempt.
isolation.kind: bubblewrap namespace; not an OCI container
isolation.network_boundary: Model-generated shell commands inherit a kernel rule that rejects socket operations and records every denied request. The Codex control process keeps only the provider connection needed for the model. Model web, app, plugin, and search capabilities are disabled.
isolation.package_runtime: Both conditions receive the same exact pruned package view: Mathlib source and the .olean, .olean.server, .olean.private, and .ir files Lean needs. Git data, traces, hashes, indexes, and other package files are absent.

provider_prompt_prefix_cache.cached_object: exact-prefix prefill key/value computation, not generated output

known_reference_protocol_deviations: Condition L receives the frozen signposted-library-v1 supplement while condition N does not. This user-directed treatment intentionally departs from the reference PDF's identical-prompt rule and is kept separate from the earlier raw-access P01 measurements.
The Codex backend has no demonstrated fixed random-seed input, so rep-01, rep-02, and rep-03 are repetition IDs only.
There is no frozen OCI container image; fresh bubblewrap namespaces are used instead.
The read-only host folders /usr, /bin, /lib, /lib64, and /etc are not one completely fingerprinted operating-system image.

Accepted proofs stop at an authenticated exact first-valid-proof submission boundary, with the root submit call blocked, descendants quiescent, and no later model response. A wall-clock interruption of an active tree can remain measurement-inexact; the matrix aborts and preserves that incident without scoring or retrying it.
The current user-authorized 5,000,000-token cap replaces the earlier 2,000,000-token project freeze and is applied identically to N and L.

The external highambench-provider-token-gate-v6 buffering/reservation layer and its sole-inflight, call-atomic token endpoint are a HighamBench execution-protocol amendment applied identically to N and L for exact accounting. Gate v6 accepts an absent upstream Content-Type only after strict complete byte-level SSE authentication and records the header bases, parser receipt, body hash/size, response identity, event counts, downstream synthesized-content-type flag, response-output manifest, and app-server delivery reconciliation. Provider totals are authoritative; the raw app-server ledger remains a structural subset. Suppressed collaboration waits, collaboration-message supersessions, and completed child responses discarded after an explicit parent interrupt each require narrowly authenticated evidence. This compatibility rule does not alter the N/L symmetry of the amendment. The frozen Codex binary is unchanged and does not itself enforce this gate; results must not be labeled strict reference-PDF HighamBench 0.2 results.
The model control process needs its provider connection even though model-accessible shell and web networking are disabled.
